description: Turn text of up to 128 bytes into an on and off signal in Morse timing, for a screen, a lamp, a smart bulb, shades or a buzzer: a dot is one unit on and a dash three, the gap inside a letter one unit off, between letters three and between words seven. Answers the Morse code, bits (one character per unit, 1 on and 0 off), timing (the on and off lengths in milliseconds, the first one on), unit_ms, duration_ms and the characters skipped for having no Morse code. Nothing is stored. No API key, no account and no sign up.

text.description: The text, at most 128 bytes of UTF-8.

unit_ms.description: The length of one unit in milliseconds, 100 by default, which a camera at 30 frames per second reads. 20 suits a light sensor, 2000 window shades.

name: encode_blink
title: Encode text as a blinking signal
